note: Wrapped swaps price themselves from their own transaction: the fee is charged in the sell asset, so a stable on either leg now prices the swap, the fee and the burn cut at the trade's own executed rate - the first real production sell (an $8,457 swap, $33.83 fee, whole fee captured) rendered as dashes and this fixes that class. The detail popup titles wrapped swaps as themselves instead of hunting for a basket behind them, says when a fee is parked at the fallback sink awaiting the sweep, and never applies the old generation's 7/8 estimate to a whole-fee-burn swap. Wrapped swaps also stopped competing with the pool-fee flood for feed slots, and stable-priced swaps now count in the portfolio volume and fee figures everywhere.
